scope: Public integration source, clean-export regression tests, dependency closure and bounded official-client subscription checks. Packaged platform and protected-data gates remain separate.

cleanExport.skips: Tests requiring the separately supplied original native runtime or frontend fixtures. No private profiles or original runtime assets are in the export.

credentialSnapshotRegression.scope: Captured credentials remain paired with the original destination across native replay clones and connection edits, including an actual loopback bridge race.

productionTextCheck.input: Synthetic fixed text only; no research content.

securityScan.scope: Final integration-source export and source ZIP only. The exact scan result and archive checksum are published as release assets VERIFICATION.json and SHA256SUMS. Historical app scans are not reused for these bytes.

packagedRelease: Full Mac/Linux/WSL, restore, managed dependencies, protected-data and runtime-distribution requirements retain their status in release-status.json. This record does not approve those gates.

installerRegression.scope: Only the exact installed Chimeric executable and workspace can be stopped; ancestor shells and unrelated commands are excluded, including paths with spaces.
